summary: Xiao-I Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing a change in its ADS-to-ordinary-share ratio from 1 ADS per 60 ordinary shares to 1 per 420, effecting a one-for-seven reverse ADS split. No ordinary shares are issued or canceled; Citibank acts as depositary, automatically exchanging every seven old ADSs for one new ADS effective September 8, 2026, with new CUSIP 98423X407. Fractional ADSs will be sold and proceeds distributed. This is a routine ratio adjustment, not a special situation; no premiums, board actions, or strategic implications. Watch for trading impact under ticker AIXI.
